scope: Actual StaffPage with BrowserRouter; strict synthetic SDK/API and localhost-only browser. No live services or accounts.

checks.case: 01 Whitespace note blocked without write
02 Whitespace task blocked without write
03 Task saves with exact params and reloads
04 Note saves and survives refresh
05 Empty response is a real empty state
06 Malformed response is unavailable rather than zero records
07 Denied response reveals no private records
08 Network rejection stays recoverable
09 Unavailable tasks are not shown as zero
10 Malformed stored date does not crash rendering
11 Missing or whitespace request owner is blocked
12 Open request missing follow-up blocked before write
13 Closed request accepts no follow-up per existing rule
14 Failed save preserves draft and releases busy state
15 Pending save prevents duplicate submission
16 Released pending save produces exactly one note
17 Sign-out clears private view
18 Sign-in network error is recoverable
19 Refresh retries tasks after connection recovery
20 Retry after refresh saves only one note
21 Lost write response refreshes committed note without automatic retry
22 Logout clears drafts before next session
23 Default staff route opens Tasks
24 Denied direct route /staff/customers
24 Denied direct route /staff/crm
24 Denied direct route /staff/catering
24 Denied direct route /staff/tasks
24 Denied direct route /staff/offers
24 Denied direct route /staff/system
25 Internal tests hidden across all five tabs; can be deliberately included
26 Kanban drag writes exact existing RPC params
27 Invalid kanban move does not write and asks for missing fields
28 Late read after sign-out cannot restore private data
29 Late write after sign-out cannot restore draft/private data
30 New York display and saved due time are independent of device timezone
31 Decision question is validated and only one pending question is offered
32 System resolves mocked form error without any email action
33 Desktop synthetic three-column screenshot
34 Mobile 375px is usable without whole-page overflow
35 Unsaved note, task and catering drafts survive tab changes
36 Unknown task write stays blocked until the task source itself reads successfully
